# Mulligan's Grille

> Wings, burgers, cold beer, good people. Port Orange's casual American sports grill.

## About

Mulligan's Grille is a casual American sports grill in Port Orange, FL. Scratch-made
soups, sauces, dressings and desserts; award-winning wings and burgers; hand-cut steaks;
seafood; salads and wraps. Family- and dog-friendly with a patio, full bar, and live
entertainment most nights of the week.

## Visit

- Address: 3830 S Nova Rd, Ste B1, Port Orange, FL 32127
- Phone: (386) 265-0653
- Hours: Mon 3:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Tue–Sun 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- Reservations: not accepted (walk-in)
